item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_conversion.go","line":119,"priority":1,"description":"The same-digest semantic replay returns before loading or validating the current Work. It therefore bypasses expected_work_revision, organizationGuard, task state, and launch-lock checks. A new create-missions event can report success after Planning/Profile was altered; authorize-plan can likewise report success while task flags or database locks are inconsistent. Only exact event receipt replay should bypass current-state checks. For a new event, reload the work and verify the expected revision, applied organization, task state, and lock/release state before treating it as an idempotent no-op. Add regressions that corrupt the organization and launch locks after attachment."},{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_organization.go","line":38,"priority":1,"description":"The pristine-task check does not cover all historical or mutable task state. A task with PreviousReviews, CorrectiveRecovery, Blocker, EvidenceStaleReason, ValidationPolicy, Requirements, or ScopeID can pass when status/attempts/response/gate are empty; configurePreparedOrganization then adopts or overwrites that history. Compare the complete allowed materialized task state (preferably against a canonical projection) and explicitly reject historical decisions/evidence. Add rejection-and-no-mutation cases for prior review/recovery and pre-existing policy/scope state."}],"limitations":["Review was limited to the supplied candidate and source excerpts; no tools were used and the supplied test outputs were not independently reproduced.","The implementation and cleanup behavior of configureManagedRepository was not supplied, so filesystem atomicity after snapshot creation could not be verified."]}
